result.keywords: This article examines manual retrieval workflows for fragile archival materials stored in dim, high-humidity facilities. It proposes a lantern-guided shelving protocol, humidity-aware labeling, and low-glare cart routing to reduce misfiling and handling damage during after-hours inventory checks. A small pilot study compares retrieval time, error rate, and staff fatigue across standard headlamp, fixed illumination, and portable diffuse-light methods.
result.title: Glass Lanterns for Coastal Archive Retrieval in Low-Light Warehouses.
